summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.85. Privileged Lab-admin account s.demir@aegean.edu authenticated eight times in ~30 minutes from a single foreign Cloudvault VPS IP (45.142.10.9, Frankfurt, DE) via the flagged vulnerable VPN appliance (vpn-edge-01). The first event is an MFA approval, after which seven consecutive portal/LMS successes occur with zero MFA prompts—consistent with post-MFA session reuse or MFA bypass on a vulnerable appliance rather than normal re-auth. No mail events or benign explanation (travel, known device, expected admin work) are present to explain the atypical ASN/geography and MFA pattern. This indicates a confirmed account takeover of a privileged account; immediate containment (disable sessions, reset credentials, revoke via the vulnerable appliance) is warranted.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
